name: Snap Rally

tracks.title: Snap Rally - main theme
tracks.style_prompt: Driving instrumental rock action score, aggressive and adrenaline-fueled, modular vehicle bowling track atmosphere, Rhythm Electric Guitar, Lead Guitar, Bass Guitar, Drums, Synth Pad, 150 BPM, memorable repeating melodic motif, instrumental, no vocals, dynamic game soundtrack score, seamless looping structure
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
(sparse ambient layer, quiet pulse)
[Verse 1 - Exploration Layer]
(clean Rhythm Electric Guitar, Synth Pad, light Hi-Hat)
[Pre-Chorus - Tension Build]
(palm-muted Rhythm Electric Guitar riff, Snare roll)
[Chorus - Combat Layer]
(full Rhythm Electric Guitar, heavy Drums, driving Bass Guitar)
[Bridge - Danger / Boss State]
(double-time Drums, harmonized Lead Guitar stabs)
[Outro]
(resolution back to ambient loop tail)
tracks.notes: Exported 32-bar loop (bars 54-86, 86.40s-137.60s, 51.20s, 2457600 frames @ 48kHz 24-bit) via SonicAlchemist export-adaptive.exe with 0.85s fade-in/fade-out clip envelopes (seam_step <= 0.000005). Integrated into /Game/Audio/Music/SW_Music_*_v001 with 4 states (Explore, Tension, Combat, Boss).
